new_work.strong_offranking_synergy: Harmonic Prodigy doubles sourced current Shaman/Wizard triggered abilities from Kessig Flamebreather, Thermo-Alchemist, Vivi Ornitier, Storm-Kiln Artist; NOT Abaddon-granted cascade nor Vivi mana activation.
new_work.new_topend_finding: Blood for the Blood God! MV11 cannot be hit by cascade from any of currently approved 100's maximum MV9 spells; Call Forth MV8 can be hit by Blasphemous Act MV9 cascade and carries two printed cascades. Mind's Desire EXCEPTION may cast MV11 Blood free regardless of MV.
stage7_finite_mechanics_findings: Solphim modifies actual damage from 1 to 2, stopping Ghyrson exactly-one-damage trigger AND Ob exactly-one-life-loss trigger on those pings.
Bloodletter modifies resulting opponent life loss from 1 to 2, stopping Ob but NOT Ghyrson's actual exactly-one-damage trigger; these cases must not be conflated.
Kessig plus Harmonic plus Ghyrson, absent Solphim/Bloodletter, resolves two grouped one-to-each opponent events for X18 total against 3 opponents and 2 Ob triggers, not 6 Ob triggers.
Kederekt post-Wheel opponent draw triggers do not retroactively qualify Wheel's own Abaddon cascade.
Spear Spewer plus Ghyrson deals self three damage on its activation and requires ready {T} ability.

stage8.discovery: Impact Tremors gives direct each-opponent 1 damage per payable Birgi FRONT + Grinning Ignus main phase loop; current 40K Lost Spawn token ETBs feed it. Nine source-live legal/U+B+R identity cards assessed.

stage9.discovery: Veyran {1}{U}{R} doubles cast/copy induced triggered abilities of ten CURRENT Abaddon permanents (among them Birgi, Lost, Keeper, Nalfeshnee, Prosper, Passionate granted to commander); does NOT double Abaddon static cascade or spell's cascade triggers, nor creature-only Ignus/Tremors ETB directly.

stage10.discovery: Existing Nightscape Familiar + front-face Birgi + Grinning Ignus generates +{C} net each sorcery-speed Ignus cycle, unlike removing Familiar for Veyran (net {C} zero). Impact Tremors + Ignus + Birgi still damages each opponent independently of Familiar. Neheb + Aggravated Assault with Abaddon-controlled Loyal Subordinate survives opposing Rule of Law when predeployed and X>=5, if permanents stay present.
stage10.source: data/grixis/m6/oracle_snapshots/Abaddon_the_Despoiler_Rev2_Scryfall_20261022.json plus stage8+stage9 live Scryfall candidates and Wizards Comprehensive Rules

stage11.discovery: One Sanctum of Stone Fangs {1}{B} surviving until own next first main causes each of 3 opponents to lose1 before hand-spell cast, hence Abaddon X3 allowing MV3 hand spell cascade; Bloodletter doubles to X6; Solphim affects only damage and does not double Shrine life loss. Mirkwood Bats adds one each-opponent life-loss trigger per token creation/sacrifice, but trigger generated by Treasure sacrificed DURING casting a spell resolves too late to enable cascade for that same spell.
stage11.source: stage8 nine-card Scryfall snapshot + baseline Oracle and stage9 Veyran source

stage12.brief: Three full-100 physical five/five/six swap comparisons test Sanctum pre-main threshold, Impact paid Ignus damage loop, Sheoldred Wheel own-turn X42/84, old cut Exalted Flamer 40K recursion+pings, Sakashima extra cascade, Mount Doom land threshold, and alternative Keeper/Nalfeshnee protected cuts. Exact sources, no win-rate claim; all remain research only.
